primary.estimand: Expected paired collision difference over fresh scenarios, averaged over the three fixed trained-model pairs.
primary.interval: Two-sided percentile 95% scenario-cluster bootstrap; 10000 replicates; RNG seed 20261111. Resample scenario IDs while retaining all fixed models and policy pairing.
primary.decision_rule: Evidence of fewer collisions for the locked QR-tail policy if the upper conditional confidence endpoint is strictly below zero. Report speed/distance regardless of collision result. Do not claim speed-independent or real-road safety benefit.

design.secondary: Other policies, traffic densities, seed variation and crossed bootstrap intervals are descriptive/exploratory; no family-wise inference claimed.
design.generalization_limit: Primary interval conditions on this selected set of trained models, architecture, rewards and governor caps; it does not cover new training runs or remove speed/action-rule differences.
design.no_tuning: No retraining, checkpoint selection, alpha adjustment or governor adjustment using these results. Further tuned models need a new untouched scenario block.
design.replays: Training seed 0, first reserved scenario 20000 at density 1, for QR tail and both governed controls; fixed before outcomes.

fixed_models.scope: Fresh scenarios conditional on the locked trained models; no new-training generalization.
